claimLedger.claim: Learn to relax, stay calm and breathe deeply; keep moving; partner support; keep open mind as you may want more pain relief; gas and air best with slow deep breaths; alternative methods mostly unproven.
claimLedger.sourceSection: NHS · Pain relief in labour · Page last reviewed: 13 March 2023
claimLedger.limitations: UK labour-ward options (Entonox, pethidine, remifentanil) differ from some Indian hospital formularies—categories matter more than brand names here.
